name: Sale Order Compare
description:
The Sale Order Compare module offers an efficient way to compare multiple sale orders in Odoo. With the help of an interactive pivot view, users can easily analyze sales data across various vendors and products. The pivot table presents detailed information, including product names, quantities sold, and subtotals. Users can filter the pivot view for a more in-depth comparison based on their specific needs. The module automates the comparison process, saving time and improving the accuracy of sales analysis.  

    **Key Features:**  
    1) **Pivot View Comparison:**  
       - Compare multiple sale orders in a structured pivot view with detailed vendor-wise sales information.  

    2) **Automated Comparison:**  
       - The system automatically compares sale orders, eliminating the need for manual data comparison.  

    3) **Customizable Analysis:**  
       - The default view shows quantity and subtotal, but users can adjust filters for customized analysis of sales data.  

    4) **Quick Vendor and Product Comparison:**  
       - View how many products were sold by which vendor, enhancing your sales strategy and vendor relationships.  

    **Use Cases:**  
    - **Sales Analysis:** Compare sales performance across vendors and products to identify top-selling items or underperforming products.  
    - **Vendor Performance Tracking:** Evaluate sales data by vendor to monitor performance and optimize vendor relations.  
    - **Business Intelligence:** Gain deeper insights into product sales, quantities, and subtotals to make informed business decisions.  

    **Supported Views:**  
    - **Navigation:** Sales → Orders → Compare Sale Orders (Select orders for comparison)  
    - **Navigation:** Sales → Reports → Pivot View (Display detailed comparison of sale orders)  
    - **Navigation:** Sales → Reports → Filters (Adjust filters for customized analysis)
summary: The Sale Order Compare module enables users to efficiently compare multiple sale orders. By utilizing an interactive pivot view, it allows businesses to view detailed comparisons across vendors, products, and customers. The pivot table displays product names, quantities, subtotals, and other sales insights. name: Website Birthday Discount
description:
The Website Birthday Discount module provides an automated birthday discount system for Odoo eCommerce, allowing businesses to reward loyal customers with special promotions on their birthdays. Customers can set their birthdate, and the system applies the discount automatically during checkout.  

    **Key Features:**  
    1) **Automatic Birthday Discount:**  
       - Customers receive a discount on their birthday, applied automatically to the shopping cart.  

    2) **Secure Birthdate Entry:**  
       - Customers can enter their birthdate once, preventing multiple discounts within the same year.  

    3) **Admin-Controlled Birthdate Updates:**  
       - If a customer enters an incorrect birthdate, the admin can modify it from the backend.  

    4) **Visible Discount in Cart:**  
       - The applied discount is clearly displayed in the cart during checkout for transparency.  

    5) **Eligibility Restriction for Existing Customers:**  
       - Only customers with a prior purchase history are eligible for the birthday discount.  

    **Use Cases:**  
    - **Retail & E-commerce Stores:** Increase customer engagement and encourage repeat purchases.  
    - **Loyalty Programs:** Reward loyal customers with exclusive birthday discounts.  
    - **Subscription-based Businesses:** Provide birthday perks to enhance customer satisfaction.  
    - **Multi-Vendor Marketplaces:** Offer unique discounts to customers from different vendors.  

    **Supported Views:**  
    - **Navigation:** Website → Settings → Define Discount Percentage (Admin sets discount rate)  
    - **Navigation:** Website → My Account → Edit Profile (Customer enters birthdate)  
    - **Navigation:** Website → eCommerce → Customers (Admin modifies incorrect birthdates)  
    - **Navigation:** Website → Shopping Cart (Discount is automatically applied on the customer’s birthday)
summary: This app allows customers to receive a special discount on their birthday when shopping on the website. Once the birthdate is set, it cannot be changed to prevent multiple discounts within the same year. However, in case of an incorrect entry, the admin can update the birthdate. name: Purchase Order Template Product
description:
The Purchase Order Template Product module enhances procurement efficiency by allowing users to create and manage predefined product templates. These templates automatically populate purchase order lines with multiple products, sections, and notes, reducing manual effort and improving bulk purchase workflows. Ideal for businesses managing large-volume purchases, the module integrates with multiple Odoo functionalities, ensuring smooth procurement operations.

    Key Features:
    1) **Predefined Product Templates:**
       - Users can create custom templates containing multiple products, sections, and notes for faster purchase order processing.

    2) **Automated Purchase Order Population:**
       - When a product template is selected in a purchase order, all associated products are automatically added to the order lines.

    3) **Bulk Procurement Optimization:**
       - Ideal for businesses managing high-volume orders, reducing repetitive data entry and improving efficiency.

    4) **Seamless Integration with Odoo Modules:**
       - Works with Purchase Orders, Vendor Pricelists, Reordering Rules, Warehouse Management, and Procurement Planning.

    5) **Multi-Company and Multi-Currency Support:**
       - Facilitates global procurement processes by supporting multiple companies and currencies.

    Use Cases:
    - **Retail & Wholesale Businesses:** Quickly place bulk purchase orders using predefined templates.
    - **Manufacturing Companies:** Streamline procurement for production materials and inventory replenishment.
    - **E-commerce & Dropshipping:** Automate purchase orders with supplier product lists.
    - **Service Providers:** Manage recurring purchases with saved templates.

    Supported Views:
    - **Navigation:** Purchase → Purchase Template (To create and manage templates)
    - **Navigation:** Purchase → Purchase Orders (To use templates in purchase orders)
summary: The Purchase Order Template Product module optimizes bulk purchasing by enabling users to create predefined product templates that simplify purchase order management in Odoo. Instead of manually adding multiple products to an order, users can select a product template, and all associated products, sections, and notes are automatically populated in the purchase order lines. This feature enhances procurement efficiency by streamlining supplier purchases and reducing data entry time. name: Purchase Order Price Compare
description:
The Purchase Order Price Compare module simplifies vendor price comparison by providing an automated tool that generates pivot tables for price evaluation. Users can compare multiple purchase orders side by side without the need for manual calculations, improving procurement efficiency and decision-making.

    Key Features:
    1) **Automated Purchase Order Comparison:**
       - Users can select multiple purchase orders, and the system generates a structured pivot table for comparison.

    2) **Pivot Table View for Better Analysis:**
       - Prices from different vendors are displayed in a pivot table format, making it easy to analyze cost differences.

    3) **Time-Saving Procurement Process:**
       - Eliminates manual price comparison, reducing errors and streamlining the vendor selection process.

    4) **Seamless Integration with Odoo Procurement Modules:**
       - Works with Purchase Orders, Vendor Pricelists, Reordering Rules, and Budget Management.

    5) **Multi-Company and Multi-Currency Support:**
       - Facilitates international procurement and vendor price comparisons.

    Use Cases:
    - **Retail & Wholesale Businesses:** Compare vendor pricing for bulk purchases.
    - **Manufacturing Companies:** Evaluate material costs before procurement.
    - **E-commerce & Dropshipping:** Optimize supplier selection with automated price comparisons.
    - **Service Providers:** Ensure cost-efficient purchases by comparing supplier quotes.

    Supported Views:
    - **Navigation:** Purchase → Purchase Orders → Compare Orders (To select orders for comparison)
    - **Navigation:** Purchase → Purchase Orders → Pivot View (To view comparison results)
summary: The Purchase Order Price Compare module enhances procurement efficiency by allowing users to compare multiple purchase orders from different vendors in Odoo. Instead of manually reviewing prices, users can select purchase orders, and the system automatically generates a pivot table for easy price comparison. name: WhatsApp Custom Template
description:
The WhatsApp Template app enhances business communication by allowing users to create and send predefined WhatsApp messages directly from Odoo. With real-time delivery, customer interaction tracking, and WhatsApp Web redirection, businesses can engage with customers efficiently.

    Key Features:
    1) **Predefined WhatsApp Message Templates:**
       - Create and manage reusable WhatsApp message templates in Odoo.

    2) **Send WhatsApp Messages to Customers:**
       - Select a customer and send a WhatsApp message instantly using predefined templates.

    3) **WhatsApp Web Integration:**
       - Automatically redirect users to WhatsApp Web with the selected template message prefilled.

    4) **Validation for Mobile Number:**
       - Prevent message sending errors by ensuring customers have valid phone numbers.

    5) **Bulk Messaging Support:**
       - Send messages to multiple customers at once for marketing and customer engagement.

    Use Cases:
    - **Customer Support & Engagement:**
      - Automate responses and manage inquiries through WhatsApp templates.

    - **Sales Follow-ups & Promotions:**
      - Notify leads, send order confirmations, and run promotional campaigns via WhatsApp.

    - **Invoice & Payment Reminders:**
      - Improve cash flow by sending automated invoice reminders to customers.

    Supported Views:
    - **WhatsApp → WhatsApp Template:**
      - Create and manage message templates.

    - **WhatsApp → WhatsApp Template → Send WhatsApp Message:**
      - Select a template and customer to send a message.

    - **WhatsApp Web Redirection:**
      - Automatically open WhatsApp Web with the message prefilled.

    - **Validation Error Handling:**
      - Alerts users when a selected customer lacks a mobile number.

name: Quick Search
description:
The Quick Search module provides an enhanced record lookup system within Odoo, allowing users to find records instantly within the active model without switching views. By eliminating manual searches, this module significantly improves productivity and user experience.

    Key Features:
    1) **Instant Record Search:**
       - Quickly locate records within the current module, reducing search time.

    2) **Seamless Module Integration:**
       - Works across various models like Sales Orders, Contacts, Invoices, and more.

    3) **Advanced Filtering:**
       - Supports keyword-based filtering for refined search results.

    4) **Time-Saving Efficiency:**
       - Eliminates tedious manual searches, improving workflow speed.

    5) **User-Friendly Interface:**
       - Simple search bar within each module for quick and easy access.

    Use Cases:
    - **Sales Teams:** Instantly locate sales orders using order numbers or customer names.
    - **Customer Support:** Quickly find customer records for efficient service resolution.
    - **Accounting Teams:** Retrieve invoice records without navigating through lists.

    Supported Views:
    - **Sales → Sales Orders:** Search orders by customer name, reference, or order number.
    - **Contacts → Customers/Vendors:** Find contacts by name, email, or phone.
    - **Accounting → Invoices:** Retrieve invoices using invoice numbers or customer names.

name: All In One Barcode
description:
The All In One Barcode app is designed to simplify and accelerate the process of managing orders, inventory, and manufacturing in Odoo. By enabling barcode scanning, this app allows users to instantly add products to sales orders, purchase orders, invoices, stock pickings, BOMs, and more. It eliminates the need for manual data entry, ensuring quick and accurate updates to order lines, quantities, and pricing, thereby boosting productivity and reducing errors in warehouse and sales processes.

    Key Features:
    1) **Barcode Scanning:**
       - Instantly add products to sales, purchase, invoice lines, stock picking, and BOM by scanning a barcode.

    2) **Quick Order Updates:**
       - Automatically insert scanned products into sales, purchase, and invoice orders, updating quantities as necessary.

    3) **Stock & BOM Integration:**
       - Update stock picking and BOM quantities using barcode scanning to ensure accurate inventory management.

    4) **Error Warnings:**
       - Receive alerts for missing barcodes, insufficient stock, or duplicate entries to prevent errors.

    Use Cases:
    - **Sales & Purchasing:**
      - Quickly process orders by scanning barcodes, reducing time spent on manual entry.
    - **Inventory Management:**
      - Easily update stock levels and manage deliveries by scanning products during stock picking and receiving.
    - **Manufacturing:**
      - Streamline the BOM creation and stock tracking processes with barcode integration.

    Supported Views:
    - **Sales → Orders → Quotation:**
      - Scan barcodes to add products to sales orders or increase their quantity.
    - **Purchase → Orders → Requests For Quotation:**
      - Scan barcodes to update purchase orders and stock levels.
    - **Inventory → Overview → Delivery Orders:**
      - Scan barcodes to quickly add products to delivery orders.
    - **Inventory → Overview → Receipts:**
      - Scan barcodes to update quantities for incoming shipments.
summary: The All In One Barcode Odoo app simplifies inventory management, order processing, stock picking, BOM (Bills of Materials), product entry, sales orders, purchase orders, invoice generation, barcode scanning, and order updates. It integrates seamlessly with Odoo’s sales, purchasing, manufacturing, inventory, and invoicing modules. name: BOM Barcode
description:
The BOM Barcode app is designed to enhance the Bill of Materials (BOM) management in manufacturing by using barcode scanning to quickly add products and update quantities. It eliminates the need for manual data entry, ensuring quick and accurate updates to the BOM and improving production efficiency. When a product is scanned, it is added to the BOM, and if the product already exists, its quantity is automatically updated. This integration streamlines workflows, reduces errors, and enhances accuracy throughout the manufacturing process.

    Key Features:
    1) **Add Product in BOM with Barcode:**
       - Quickly add products to the BOM by scanning their barcodes.

    2) **Increase Quantity in BOM with Barcode:**
       - Automatically increase the quantity of a product in the BOM when scanned.

    Use Cases:
    - **Manufacturing:**
      - Streamline the process of adding products to the BOM and updating quantities with barcode scanning.

    Supported Views:
    - **Manufacturing → Products → Product Variants:**
      - Manually add product barcodes to use them in the BOM scanning process.

    - **Manufacturing → Products → Bill of Materials:**
      - Scan barcodes to add products directly to the BOM.

    - **Manufacturing → Products → Bill of Materials → BOM Lines:**
      - Scan the barcode to add products to the BOM lines or increase their quantities if they already exist.

description:
The Custom Fields in Stock Location app makes it simple to add and manage custom fields in Odoo Stock Locations. No coding required—just configure fields in a few clicks.

    1) **Create Fields Easily:**

description:

Perfect for performance tracking, SLA monitoring, bottleneck detection, and agile project reporting.

name: Odoo Global Discount on Sale,Purchase & Invoice with Tax calculation
description:
Odoo doesn't support discounts with tax calculations, but this module enables discounts in Sales
     Orders, Purchase Orders, Customer Invoices, and Vendor Bills. It offers Fixed and Percentage discounts, applicable
      on individual line items or the total amount—before or after tax. Users can configure discounts globally or per
      order line, set up discount accounts separately for Sales and Purchases, and generate journal entries when 
      invoices are validated.
